history_summary: Record seven reference correspondences and eight complete ambiguity sets for fifteen HAMBI species descriptors.
history_details: The unchanged native engine added seven reference blocks, preserved every ordered alternative in eight ambiguity sets, changed fifteen statuses and appended two native inline events. All sixteen HAMBI stock identities remain distinct. Paraniabella yanshanensis at index 14 remains untouched with native null and UNRESOLVED; missing correspondence is not absence or a reason to replace its valid current name. Three blocks use species-name routes and four use exact species IDs; these are generic reference populations, not collection-stock assemblies or the source's WGS-derived 16S mapping. Rounded fractions are not exact support numerators. Preserve the historical notes about unavailable crosswalk access, all source quotations, old history and biological content. The sixteen-day, eight-cycle inoculum experiment does not establish persistence of all stocks; OD-scaled abundance is not viable cell counting, and controlled carbon outcomes do not selectively establish trait or pH mediation or alternative stable states. Preserve the prior batch 50 scientific limitations, Hanford and C6 boundaries, and open discussions. This scoped technical correction is not a new full scientific review, source-reference validation, generated-product check, issue closure or aggregate QC.
